post.description: Returns a paged list of computed completeness scores (score value, validation status, last update dates), optionally filtered by context and/or entity id. Use for bulk retrieval across entities; for a single entity's per-requirement pass/fail breakdown use GET /scores/{entityId}/{context} instead. Entities with no computed score yet for the given filters are simply omitted from the results, not reported as an error.

get.summary: Get detailed scores for single entity.
get.description: Returns the computed completeness score for one entity in one context, plus the pass/fail/invalid result for every requirement evaluated. Use for a single entity; for many entities at once use get_scores (POST /scores/list), which returns summary scores without the per-requirement breakdown. Returns the same payload as GET /requirements/entity/{entityId}/{context} — either can be used. Fails if no score has been computed yet for this entityId/context combination, which can also occur if the entity itself doesn't exist.

parameters.name: entityId
parameters.description: Id of the entity (product) to get the score for.

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Context the score was computed for, e.g. 'en'.

ValidationDetails.title: Status of validation.
ValidationDetails.description:
Subtypes mapping
| Requirement details | Requirement types |
|---|---|
| CompoundAttributeDefinitionValidationDetails | MISSING_COMPOUND_ATTRIBUTE |
| AttributeDefinitionValidationDetails | INVALID_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE |
| DictionaryValueFilterValidationDetails | DICTIONARY_VALUE_NOT_EXIST_IN_FILTER |
| VariantAttributesValidationDetails | MISSING_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTE, MISSING_VARIANT_VALUE, INVALID_VARIANT_VALUE|
| CategoryAttributesValidationDetails | MISSING_CATEGORY_ATTRIBUTE, MISSING_CATEGORY_VALUE, INVALID_CATEGORY_VALUE|
